query: Oh my, my cat just knocked over my favorite potted succulent this morning, soil got all over my desk, I spent half an hour cleaning it up and he still looks totally unapologetic about it. Oh right, I’m reaching out because I need to return an item from my delivered order #W9571698: the item with SKU 6065192424, and I’d like the refund to go back to my gift card with the number gift_card_7250692.
